reviewer_relation: Same subagent prepared R2; this is a fresh source audit, not an independently executed or second-author validation.

findings.issue: Returns placeholder_sample_only=True after checking sample schema/IDs only; sample output values are not checked against the declared constant placeholder. A supplied/tampered sample containing real heldout targets could still pass this claimed invariant.
findings.minimal_fix: R3 validates exact expected sample output constant without reading heldout labels; ID dtype/value equality and declared ordered test columns are checked too.

findings.issue: all_refs.update can silently replace an immutable expected SHA when an artifact path equals the immutable-source path. Relative paths are also resolved against ambient cwd rather than an explicit work root.
findings.minimal_fix: R3 canonicalizes each ref from explicit work root, rejects conflicting SHAs for same canonical path, validates nonnull SHA/path records and returns authorizes_label_read=False for hash-inventory-only success.

findings.issue: Combined template has per-kind control recipes and null partition/clock values, while hash helper expects singular protected_control_recipe_sha256 and actual per-task outer partition/clock. It is not an executable judge plan.
findings.minimal_fix: R3 adds explicit per-task plan instantiation binding actual nonnull source/indices/rowmap/hash/schema/derived-input/control refs and shared10800 clock; semantic judge still remains unimplemented.

findings.issue: csv.reader implicitly assumes comma while frozen runtime supports comma/semicolon/tab/pipe. The prototype would reject or misread a different original CSV dialect before otherwise valid materialization.
findings.minimal_fix: R3 requires an explicitly frozen source_delimiter from the original trusted-reader probe; writes derived comma CSV and demands exact reader roundtrip.

findings.issue: Functions rely on caller-correct features and check only primary target explicitly. Operational contract should bind all_targets, exact ordered test schema and actual splitter proof to prevent wrong-role/mismatched partition inputs.
findings.minimal_fix: R3 verifies all declared targets excluded, unique bounded column lists and expected partitionSHA before writing; scoped current value-output tasks remain unchanged.

findings.issue: CLI deliberately refuses materialization. There is no bounded supervisor/phase ledger/source+exact registration, derived-inner semantic evaluator, fixed-control iteration-tree verifier or once-only numeric outer judge. Admission arithmetic and boolean/hash checks are not these implementations.
findings.minimal_fix: Keep notoperational status; implement thin trusted controller and validators, then meaningful source/IO fixtures under existing resource caps. No new OS/ACL requirement.

findings.issue: Directory separation is not a security claim, but this experiment only needs trusted algorithm-facing source/IO invariants. Materializer may stratify/read original labels; agent+workers must use derived train/test only; judge opens targets after seal. An OS sandbox is not required by this review.
findings.minimal_fix: R3 removes ACL/OS-isolation implications; use explicit role/source/job-path read-flow audit and meaningful I/O fixtures, without permission prompts or global configuration.

findings.issue: Phase totals are exactly10800 and setup startup is already charged; admit_phase has no actual clock assignment, process timeout/memory/ownership or phase receipt sequencing. Source458/exact23 are inherited inventories, not new gate passes.
findings.minimal_fix: Future controller enforces caps, full remaining mandatory reservations, per-phase cleanup/report accounting and once-only sealed scoring. No cap reset/reinvestment; setup600source incl registered newcontracts+180exact+120materialization.

next: Make minimal source-only corrections in NEW validation-next-dev-r3 preserving R2. Operational missing contracts remain explicit; no new user approval/OS/ACL requirement.
